title: Coming to America
tagline: A prince walks into a burger joint in Queens.
about: An African prince goes to Queens to find a bride and takes a job at a fast food joint.
cue: Serve the burgers when the Big Mick comes out at McDowell's.
faces: Double beef, cheese, pickles, shredded lettuce, onion and house sauce on a three-piece bun. No sesame seeds.
The house burger at McDowell’s. Two patties, three-piece bun, no sesame seeds. Any likeness is pure coincidence.

    StartersGolden friesThin-cut fries, twice fried and salted straight from the oil.The golden side of McDowell’s.How to make it1kg russet potatoes2 L vegetable oil for frying1 tsp fine saltCut the potatoes into thin fries and soak in cold water.Dry well.Heat the oil to 140°C and fry the potatoes, then rest.Fry again at 190°C until golden and crisp.Salt straight away and serve hot.Beef patties from the corner shopSpiced beef, curry powder and thyme in flaky golden pastry.From the shop next door to the barbershop.How to make it1 brown onion, finely diced2 tbsp vegetable oil400g beef mince2 tsp mild curry powder1 tsp dried thyme1 tsp salt125ml beef stock30g dry breadcrumbs4 sheets of frozen shortcrust pastry1 tsp ground turmeric1 egg, beaten1 bottle hot sauceSoften the onion in the oil, then brown the mince with the curry powder, thyme and salt.Add the stock and simmer until almost dry, then stir in the breadcrumbs and cool.Heat the oven to 200°C. Brush the pastry sheets with turmeric mixed into the beaten egg and cut two 12cm rounds from each.Spoon the filling onto half of each round, fold over and crimp with a fork. Brush the tops with the rest of the egg.Bake on lined trays until golden and flaky, about 25 minutes. Serve hot with hot sauce.MainsBig Mick burgerDouble beef, cheese, pickles, shredded lettuce, onion and house sauce on a three-piece bun. No sesame seeds.No sesame seeds on our buns. Not one.How to make it100g mayonnaise2 tbsp sweet relish1 tsp yellow mustard1/2 tsp paprika1 tsp vinegar800g beef mince8 slices of American cheese6 three-piece sesame burger buns1/2 iceberg lettuce, shredded1 brown onion, diced12 dill pickle slicesMix the mayonnaise, relish, mustard, paprika and vinegar for the sauce.Shape the mince into 8 thin patties.Smash the patties in a hot pan and add the cheese.Toast the buns.Build each with sauce, lettuce, onion, pickles and patties in the three-piece bun.SweetsApple turnoversFlaky puff pastry filled with buttery cinnamon apple.A sweet finish from the counter.How to make it3 apples, diced30g butter50g caster sugar1 tsp cinnamon2 sheets of puff pastry1 egg, beatenCook the apples with the butter, sugar and cinnamon.Cool.Cut the pastry into quarters, fill, fold into triangles and crimp.Brush with egg and bake at 200°C.DrinksVanilla thick shakeVanilla ice cream and cold full-cream milk, blended thick.Four tall glasses, one royal order.How to make it1.5 L vanilla ice cream600ml cold full cream milkChill four tall glasses.Blend three scoops of ice cream with some of the milk until thick and smooth, one shake at a time.Pour into a chilled glass and serve with a wide straw.
